paragraphs.source_en: Houston merely stared at him, and without warning John shoved him hard in the chest; Houston ran into his chair and sat down involuntarily, bounced up going for John, but Chang jumped between them, saying "Wait a second, Sam, wait a second," while John shouted "Get out of my rooms!" over and over at the top of his lungs, bumping against Chang's back and glaring over his shoulder into Houston's red face. John nearly burst into laughter at the sight; his high spirits had returned with the success of the shove, and he stalked to the door bellowing "Get out! Get out! Get out!" so that Houston would not see the grin on his face. Chang pulled his angry colleague out into the hall and John followed. The three of them stood there, Chang carefully placing himself between his partner and John. He was bigger than either of them, and now he faced John with a worried, irritated look.
